sloka: वादयन्ति तथा शान्तिम् लासयन्ति अपि च अपरे ।नाटकानि अपरे प्राहुर् हास्यानि विविधानि च ॥२-६९-४॥
transliteration: vādayanti tathā śāntim lāsayanti api ca apare ।nāṭakāni apare prāhur hāsyāni vividhāni ca ॥2-69-4॥

translations.english: In order to provide mental peace to Bharata, some played stringed instruments while some enacted dramatic scenes, some danced and cracked various kinds of jokes.
